summary.name: Wanderboat
summary.one_liner: Wanderboat.ai is an AI travel and local-life assistant for finding things to do, places to eat and drink, local events, and hotels in your area or a destination.
use_cases: Browsing local events and live shows
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a search and discovery interface for local places, events, food and drinks, and hotels, with a Discover view that can be switched between list and map. Users can enter a destination, dates and number of guests to search for stays, and create trips. A chat-style prompt box accepts natural-language requests such as finding a hike, coffee, brunch, or nightlife nearby, and shows curated "Today's Inspo" categories like Coffee Fix and Late-Night Bites. The page also mentions location access for nearby results and a mobile "on the Go" version for exploring wherever you are. No technical details about the underlying AI or data sources are given.
notable: Natural-language chat prompts for local recommendations
List and map views for places and events
Trip creation and hotel search by dates and guests
caveats: Pricing and any paid tiers are not stated on the page
Nearby results depend on allowing location access
Page text is mostly interface labels with few concrete details about features or data coverage
